message.content: In the 2026 California governor's race, Xavier Becerra (D) has a mixed record on Palestinian-justice issues. At the 2024 World Health Assembly, he called for a ceasefire, hostage release, increased humanitarian aid for Gaza, and a path to a two-state solution. In a 2026 interview, asked whether Israel's actions in Gaza were genocide, he criticized Netanyahu's conduct and called for international accountability without answering yes or no. In a 2026 gubernatorial debate, he referred to the US-Israeli war in Iran as illegal, though the reporting characterizes the remark as criticizing form rather than crime. CAIR Action endorsed him in the general phase, and Muslim Democrats of Southern California also endorsed him. On the Israel-aligned side, the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated mission includes supporting Israel as a secure Jewish state, carried its primary endorsement forward to the general; the American Federation of Musicians Local 47, the Asian American Action Fund, and the Union of American Physicians and Dentists all endorsed him as well. Vote for Peace rated him Neutral in the general phase.
